Harry’s photographs of the 1982 Tour de France are certainly of an era. Indeed, it’s likely that we’ll never see their kind again, mainly because photographers are no longer allowed to take pictures from a motorbike “inside” the peloton. They are allowed, at certain times, to go ahead of the peloton and take pictures looking back, but never from within the peloton.

A peloton is a group of riders in a bike race. The term comes from the French word pelote, which means "ball". Riders in a peloton save energy by drafting behind the riders in front of them. It is a beautiful thing to watch the professional cyclists ride along in a big group with all their different colored jerseys. Peloton is also the name of an indoor bike which has a cult-like following and I will admit I am a devoted Peloton rider. This is a list of book by Peloton instructors as well as one about the company and its creation. #IndyPLAdults
